plan.title: fail-closed: enforce #1430 consumer-path denylist on installerManagedMatchers (SPEC must break CI)

narratives.Description: fail-closed: enforce #1430 consumer-path denylist on installerManagedMatchers (SPEC must break CI)
narratives.Overview:
## Problem

The #1430 mixed-change invariant is **documented but not enforced**.

SPECIFICATION.md (critical nuance on deft-core-guard):

> do NOT exempt consumer-authored vBRIEF content: `xbrief/PROJECT-DEFINITION.xbrief.json` and `xbrief/**/*.xbrief.json` are the user's data; if those are mixed with a `.deft/core/**` change the guard SHOULD still fire.

That contract is prose only. `installerManagedMatchers()` in `packages/core/src/init-deposit/hygiene.ts` is a single list that feeds:

1. deposit / `frameworkStagePaths` staging  
2. deposited `deft-core-guard.yml` ERE via `installerManagedGuardEre()`

Any one-line allowlist add ships to every consumer on the next deposit with **no CI failure** if it violates SPEC.

### Evidence (v0.91.0)

- #3013 goal: seed minimal PD on **init** for one-shot `project:render` (correct).
- #3016 implementation: added PD exact matchers to `installerManagedMatchers()` (wrong mechanism — seed ≠ permanent installer-managed).
- Result: consumer guard exempted PD; core+PD PRs can pass `no-mixed-core-and-app`.
- Caught downstream: Greptile P1 on `deftai/statusreport#160`; consumer workaround `statusreport#161`; symptom ticket **#3029**.

**Root cause (not #3029 itself):** standing #1430 rules were advisory. Allowlist mutation and merge paths could violate them and stay green.

Related ops note (consumer babysit): detector/`pr:watch` CLEAN can undercount Greptile P-badges — separate host/process hardening; this issue is the **product fail-closed** gap.

## Suggested fix

### 1. Immediate symptom (blocks #3029)
- Remove `xbrief/PROJECT-DEFINITION.xbrief.json` and `vbrief/PROJECT-DEFINITION.vbrief.json` from `installerManagedMatchers()`.
- Keep #3013 **seed create** on init (`seedMinimalProjectDefinition`) — create ≠ allowlist.
- Ensure `frameworkStagePaths` on **update** does not stage PD alongside `.deft/core`.
- If greenfield init still needs a first commit with seed+core: use an **init-only** staging flag, not the permanent guard allowlist.

### 2. Fail-closed denylist (the actual root fix)
Add an explicit **consumer-must-fire** set that must **never** appear in `installerManagedMatchers()` / guard ERE, e.g.:

- `xbrief/PROJECT-DEFINITION.xbrief.json`
- `vbrief/PROJECT-DEFINITION.vbrief.json`
- `xbrief/**/*.xbrief.json` scope briefs (except documented installer markers: `.deft-version`, lifecycle `.gitkeep`, schemas/, migration/, xbrief.md)
- Mirror for legacy vbrief scope files if applicable

Encode as:

```ts
// hygiene.ts (sketch)
export const CONSUMER_GUARD_MUST_FIRE: readonly string[] = [
  "xbrief/PROJECT-DEFINITION.xbrief.json",
  "vbrief/PROJECT-DEFINITION.vbrief.json",
  // ...
];

export function assertInstallerAllowlistHonors1430(): void {
  for (const path of CONSUMER_GUARD_MUST_FIRE) {
    if (isInstallerManagedPath(path)) {
      throw new Error(`#1430 violation: ${path} must not be installer-managed`);
    }
  }
}
```

Call from:

- unit tests (always)
- optionally deposit/scaffold entry so a bad matcher cannot emit a guard workflow

### 3. Regression tests (`hygiene.test.ts`)
Pin both directions:

| Case | Expect |
|------|--------|
| `isInstallerManagedPath("xbrief/PROJECT-DEFINITION.xbrief.json")` | `false` |
| guard ERE | does **not** contain PROJECT-DEFINITION |
| simulated diff: `.deft/core/**` + PD | classified as mixed (fail) |
| simulated diff: `.deft/core/**` + `xbrief/.deft-version` only | not mixed (pass) — keep #2277 |
| seed on init still creates PD when missing | unchanged #3013 behavior |

Optional: small pure helper `classifyMixedCoreAndApp(changedPaths)` shared by tests and documented as the TS twin of the shell guard.

### 4. Docs / SPEC cross-link
- One line in hygiene.ts module header: allowlist MUST honor SPEC #1430 denylist; see `CONSUMER_GUARD_MUST_FIRE`.
- #3029 closes when matchers fixed + tests green.
- This issue stays open until denylist + tests (and preferably deposit-time assert) land.

### 5. Out of scope here
- OpenClaw babysit / `pr:watch` P-badge undercount (file separately on OC or directive review-cycle if desired).
- Rewriting all historical SPEC narrative.

## Acceptance

- [ ] PD (and other consumer scope paths per SPEC) **not** in `installerManagedMatchers()`
- [ ] `hygiene.test.ts` fails CI if anyone re-adds them
- [ ] #3013 init seed still works without permanent guard exemption
- [ ] #2277 xbrief/.deft-version allowlist retained
- [ ] Deposited `coreGuardWorkflowContent()` / refresh does not reintroduce PD exemption
- [ ] #3029 closed by the matcher removal PR (or same PR)
- [ ] CHANGELOG note under Unreleased

## Non-goals

- Making PROJECT-DEFINITION framework-owned
- Weakening no-mixed-core-and-app
- Consumer hand-edits as the durable fix (statusreport#161 is temporary)

## Refs

| Ref | Role |
|-----|------|
| #1430 | Original guard + invariant |
| SPEC ~“do NOT exempt consumer-authored…” | Written contract |
| #3013 | Seed goal (valid) |
| #3016 / v0.91.0 | Introduced allowlist regression |
| #2277 | Legitimate xbrief marker allowlist |
| #3029 | Symptom: PD currently allowlisted |
| statusreport#160 | Consumer deposit of bad guard |
| statusreport#161 | Consumer workaround (remove PD exemption) |

## Source

Postmortem 2026-08-01: statusreport Directive 0.91 upgrade; Greptile P1; root-cause analysis — advisory invariants, not missing design.
